item.title: Self-Hosted Container Seccomp Profile Management: AppArmor vs Seccomp vs Firejail (2026)
item.description: Container security extends far beyond image scanning and network isolation. At the kernel level, three complementary security mechanisms — Seccomp, AppArmor, and Firejail — restrict what processes inside containers can actually do. These are not alternatives to each other but rather defense-in-depth layers that work together to create a robust container sandbox. Understanding how each mechanism works and how to manage them effectively is critical for running containers securely in production.
